known_fixes: The existing .codepress/dev-server/Dockerfile.web is a thin Live Dev Server image without source or dependency installation; generated a self-contained Dockerfile.codepress for the web frontend.
Pinned the legacy CRA toolchain to Node 18 with Yarn 1.22.22 and installed dependencies during the image build.
discovery_notes: This repository contains a legacy Create React App frontend in web/ and a separate Django 1.11 backend in server/. The durable app-server recipe targets the existing, independently runnable web frontend on port 3000; the Django service has no canonical combined start command, has no built frontend assets, and is not part of this single-server recipe.
